title: Fizzy Juice King Bar 100ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
Bringing to vaping life all of your favourite fruit soda and cola flavours, these 100ml Fizzy Juice King Bar Shortfills will definitely put some fizz into your vaping. With 27 flavours to choose from, all bringing fresh and fizzy flavours to experience, you and your taste buds will be left with quite the fabulous impression due to being manufactured with the highest level of quality control always in place.
To get the best out of any of these Fizzy Juice King Bar flavours, vaping with Sub-Ohm and DTL (Direct to Lung) pods and/or kits will deliver the ideal results due the e-liquids having a higher VG ratio. Excellent flavour and incredible vapour production with little to no hits to the throat as you enjoy your chosen flavour. In addition, there is room to apply two 18mg nicotine shots to create a 120 e-liquid with 3mg of nicotine content to enjoy.
– Made In Malaysia
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
– 100ml E-Liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 18mg Nicotine Shots For 3mg Nicotine Content
– 70VG/30PG
– Ideal for Sub-Ohm & DTL Devices & Kits
– Childproof Cap & Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD Compliant
Flavours:
Watermelon Ice
